name: GA4 Website Reports
summary: Exported Google Analytics 4 reports describing what visitors did on the website after arriving.
whatItContains: Sessions and users by traffic source or campaign, landing page rows, engagement metrics such as engagement rate and average engagement time, and counts of the key events configured as conversions.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Compare advertising traffic with on-site behaviour
Flag landing pages that receive traffic but show weak engagement
Surface differences between ad-platform and website conversion counts for review
Describe what the numbers suggest and what still needs checking
accessMethod: Manual CSV or spreadsheet export from the GA4 reporting interface
